description: An exterior facade of a modern farmhouse-style structure photographed at golden hour. The building is clad in white vertical board-and-batten siding with crisp dark trim accenting a wide garage door fitted with a grid of multi-pane glass panels at the upper half and solid white panels below. Heavy rough-hewn wood brackets in warm honey-brown support an overhanging eave above the garage opening, adding rustic craft to the otherwise clean facade. A concrete apron extends across the foreground, and small river stones are inset in a linear strip near the foundation. Low ornamental shrubs anchor each lower corner of the facade, and a slender deciduous sapling stands to the left in freshly planted mulch. In the background, open green meadow and a tree line are visible under a warm sunset sky glowing in amber and gold, with the sunset reflection caught in the garage door glass. Warm amber glows emanate symmetrically from mounted positions flanking the garage door on each side of the wall, casting soft light pools against the white siding. The camera is positioned at standing eye-level, oriented in a three-quarter view of the exterior corner, with a slightly wide lens capturing both the garage facade and the right side of the building. The composition is off-center with the garage door occupying the central third and open sky visible to the left.
